'''0.23b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that adjusted equipment damage and repairs.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Weapons of high damage per shot wear-out speed reduced
* Equipment repairs cost reduced 4 times
* Cost of critical malfunction fix reduced to 100 [[rubles]]
* Cost of ammo increased by 10%-50% depending on type

===User Interface===
* Fixed the use of stash cards, in case they were first issued after the match
* Fixed displaying of quests after reentering a match
* Fixed displaying of matchmaking. Now permissible match range is displayed correctly

===Optimization===
* Fixed algorithm of identifying available video memory
